steps.name: Schedule overlapping B
steps.do: Schedule second item at overlapping time.
steps.expect: Conflict picker or overlap warning appears.

steps.name: Conflict picker
steps.do: Use multi-select non-overlapping resolution if shown.

steps.name: Proceed without selection
steps.do: Find **Proceed Anyway** / proceed-without-selection if offered; try once.

steps.name: Unresolved messaging
steps.do: Leave a conflict unresolved if UI allows, then try save.

steps.name: Add more activities prompt
steps.do: If “add more activities?” style prompt appears, note it.

steps.name: WE overlap if needed
steps.do: If ITIN-07 did not cover WE overlap, force WE vs animal overlap.

steps.name: Save issues summary
steps.do: Trigger **Your Itinerary Has the Following Issues:** if applicable.

steps.name: No silent double-book
steps.expect: No silent double-booking without prior warning.
